facts.text: Cornell College runs entirely on the One Course At A Time block plan, where students and faculty focus on a single course for 18 days at a time, taking classes between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m.

sources.title: Cornell College - Study One Course At A Time
sources.quote: One Course At A Time is Cornell College's distinctive approach to academic scheduling where students take one class for 18 days before moving to their next course.
